rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` has front matter (`name: habeas-requirements`), so it is a bundled skill and a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.workflow`.

The requirement has one obligation. The skill must open, before any other section, with its workflow as ordered steps.

- After the front matter comes the `# Habeas requirements` title. A two-sentence preamble follows it. The preamble states the governing principle and points to the habeas skill. It is not a separate section.
- The first `##` section is `## Workflow`. It holds seven numbered steps, written as checklist items `- [ ] 1.` through `- [ ] 7.`. The numbering gives the order, and the steps run in sequence from the starting-point check to evidence authoring.
- Every other `##` section comes after it: `## Choosing references`, `## What the review checks` and `## Gotchas`.

One point could be read the other way. The steps use checklist-bullet syntax with a number inside, not a bare Markdown ordered list. They are still explicitly numbered and ordered, so I count them as ordered steps.

No violation matches were listed for this site. The skill meets the requirement, and I found no gap.
